snippet.title: Mass Effect 3: Rebellion Multiplayer Trailer
snippet.description: New Mass Effect 3 Rebellion DLC Pack available Tuesday, May 29th for Xbox 360, Playstation 3, and PC at no additional cost to those who redeemed an online pass for ME3!
